caption: The drawing depicts two ceramic jugs on a plain, light beige background. Both jugs are painted in shades of grayish-blue with darker blue accents. The jug on the left has a bulbous body, a short neck, a slightly pinched spout, and features the number "1791" painted on its front. This jug also displays two ornate spiral designs on each side of the neck. The jug on the right has a similar shape but is shown with a single broad handle attached from the neck to the shoulder of the vessel. It also features two spiral designs in blue near the top portion of the body, with no visible numerals. Both jugs have small, rounded bases and are positioned side by side, each facing slightly inwards for a partial profile view.
title: Vinegar Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
